title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 10: Ethnic groups of Vietnam (Set 1)

lessons.title: Ethnic groups of Vietnam
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Ethnic groups of Vietnam (Set 1) ngay nhé!

(Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.)

lessons.title: Ethnic groups of Vietnam
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng luyện tập các từ vựng bạn vừa học nhé!

(Nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang các bài tập tiếp theo.)

vocabTable.meaning: thuộc chủ điểm Ethnic groups of Vietnam (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: This is a large, shared building where people from a village gather for meetings, festivals, and other important events. It is common in many ethnic groups in Vietnam. What is it?

vocabTable.meaning: thuộc chủ điểm Ethnic groups of Vietnam (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: This is a round metal instrument that makes a loud sound when you hit it. Many people in Vietnam, especially in the Central Highlands, use it in festivals and ceremonies.

vocabTable.meaning: thuộc chủ điểm Ethnic groups of Vietnam (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: This is a community of people who share the same language, culture, traditions, and history. For example, in Vietnam, it can be the Kinh, H’Mong, Tay, and Dao, etc. What is it?

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Ethnic groups of Vietnam (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: Complete the text, using the words given. You do not need to use all the words. ethnic staircase posts features communal folk Emma: I visited the Central Highlands last summer, and I saw a beautiful 18.1  house. It’s a big house made of wood where people hold meetings and festivals. Jake: That sounds amazing! Was it built on pillars like a stilt house? Emma: Yes, it was! The tall 18.2 make the house strong and keep it safe from flooding. Jake: That’s so interesting. The culture of 18.3 groups in Vietnam is really special. Emma: Absolutely! Each group has its own unique 18.4 , like traditional clothes, music, and houses. Jake: I’d love to visit one day and learn more about their traditions.
